 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**The misspelled word is 'Oppertunity'.**

__
 
• **The correct spelling would be 'Opportunity'.**
 
• The word '**Opportunity**' is a **noun** which means 'a set of circumstances that makes it possible to do something'. **(अवसर)**
 
 
• **For Example -** 
 
• Don’t miss the opportunity to learn something new.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer would be** 'Oppertunity'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Let's understand the meanings of the other marked words - **

 
• **Appearance -** the way that someone or something looks **(दिखावट)**
 
• **Immigration - **the action of coming to live permanently in a foreign country **(प्रव्रजन)**
 
• **Astronaut -** a person who is trained to travel in a spacecraft **(अंतरिक्ष यात्री)**
